audit_name: OPS-02 C18 Performance Collapse Causal Hypothesis and Diagnostic Matrix

hypotheses.name: True Distribution Shift (OPS01 vs OPS02)
hypotheses.description: OPS-01 was derived from 27 parent scenes; OPS-02 expanded to 64 parent datatakes encompassing broader environmental and geographic conditions, introducing genuine out-of-distribution difficulty.
hypotheses.evidence_available: OPS-02 spans 5 marginal seas and multiple ocean basins not in OPS-01; parent clusters are strictly disjoint across partitions.
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Direct zero-shot evaluation of C8/C10 model weights on the frozen OPS-02 DEV set.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Run read-only inference of C8/C10 checkpoint on the 40 OPS-02 DEV samples (0 training, < 1 minute compute).
hypotheses.supports_if: C8/C10 achieves similarly low mIoU (< 10%) on OPS-02 DEV.

hypotheses.name: Geographic / Temporal Disconnect Across Partitions
hypotheses.description: DEV clusters are concentrated in specific geographic regions or seasons that differ systematically from TRAIN clusters.
hypotheses.evidence_available: ops02_geographic_coverage_v1.json and ops02_temporal_coverage_v1.json show multi-basin spread, but DEV has specific marginal sea clusters.
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Cluster-by-cluster DEV error analysis correlating geographic basin with IoU.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Tabulate per-cluster confusion and mIoU across the 12 DEV clusters from existing predictions.
hypotheses.supports_if: Certain DEV clusters perform at > 25% while others perform at ~0%.
hypotheses.falsifies_if: All 12 DEV clusters perform uniformly poorly regardless of basin or season.

hypotheses.name: Class Support and Sparsity Sensitivity
hypotheses.description: Macro-averaging over 11 classes is severely depressed by ultra-sparse lookalikes (HM has 117 px, OF has 1.7k px, RF has 9.5k px) and classes with 0 TP.
hypotheses.evidence_available: AF (39k px), RF (9.6k px), and HM (117 px) have IoU=0.0 on DEV. Removing them raises dominant phenomena average to 14.50%.
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Comparison of class pixel ratios in OPS-01 DEV vs OPS-02 DEV.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Compute exact class pixel frequencies in historical OPS-01 DEV.
hypotheses.supports_if: OPS-01 DEV had substantially higher minority-class presence or fewer zero-TP classes.
hypotheses.falsifies_if: OPS-01 DEV had identical ultra-sparse support but achieved > 30% on all sparse classes.

hypotheses.name: Input Domain / Preprocessing Discrepancy
hypotheses.description: Subtle discrepancies in log1p, standardization, or dtype between OPS-01 training and OPS-02 training degraded representation learning.
hypotheses.evidence_available: Phase 4 verified standardization mu=4.424158 and sigma=0.469261 match C15 protocol exactly. Pixel values are centered around 0.
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Comparison of exact pixel distribution statistics between OPS-01 raw images and OPS-02 raw images.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Compute Kolmogorov-Smirnov distribution test between OPS-01 and OPS-02 TRAIN pixel intensities.
hypotheses.supports_if: Significant radiometric distribution shift (e.g. median shift > 1.0) is detected.
hypotheses.falsifies_if: Pixel distributions match closely under two-sample KS test.

hypotheses.name: Metric Implementation Discrepancy
hypotheses.description: The formula used to compute DEV mIoU in C16 differed from C8/C10, causing an artificial score drop.
hypotheses.evidence_available: Phase 3 audited compute_metrics vs exp07_reference.py; both yield 0.049399 on DEV predictions.
hypotheses.evidence_missing: None. Forensic audit confirmed metric formula is mathematically identical on the 40 DEV samples.
hypotheses.supports_if: N/A (Falsified by C17 and C18 audits).
hypotheses.falsifies_if: CONFIRMED_FALSIFIED: Metric code is mathematically harmonized; the 4.94% is not a metric artifact.

hypotheses.name: Sampler Implementation Discrepancy (Candidate F)
hypotheses.description: Candidate F hybrid sampling starved certain classes or clusters during training epochs.
hypotheses.evidence_available: Phase 6 proved all 12 classes are drawn in every epoch (72 draws), and 30-35 parent clusters are exposed per epoch.
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Empirical comparison of training loss curves under uniform random sampling vs Candidate F.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Simulate batch-level class exposure statistics across 30 epochs.
hypotheses.supports_if: Minority classes are shown to have high variance or multi-epoch starvation.
hypotheses.falsifies_if: Class exposure is smooth and well-distributed across epochs.

hypotheses.name: Optimization Instability or Over-Weighting
hypotheses.description: Extremely high loss weights (HM=18.24, OF=4.21, RF=2.96) destabilized gradients or caused the network to aggressively over-predict foreground onto open seawater.
hypotheses.evidence_available: Confusion matrix shows massive under-prediction of Background (only 62.9k predicted out of 643.8k true BG pixels; 72% misclassified as MCC and IWs).
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Gradient norm logs across training epochs for high-weight vs low-weight classes.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Controlled diagnostic comparing unweighted CrossEntropyLoss vs square-root median weighted loss on a fixed slice subset.
hypotheses.supports_if: Unweighted or moderated weighting restores background detection and stabilizes IoU.
hypotheses.falsifies_if: Unweighted loss produces identical background collapse.

hypotheses.name: Label Ambiguity / Domain Mismatch
hypotheses.description: Natural SAR phenomena (e.g. low wind areas vs biological slicks, or pure ocean waves vs internal waves) share similar dark/bright backscatter signatures, causing inter-class confusion under out-of-distribution conditions.
hypotheses.evidence_available: Confusion matrix reveals that 29.6k BS pixels were predicted as IWs, and 160.4k IWs pixels were predicted as LWA.
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Visual inspection of prediction overlays on high-confusion DEV tiles.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Render prediction masks vs ground truth masks for the top 5 high-confusion DEV tiles (no training).
hypotheses.supports_if: Model predictions correspond to plausible physical signatures that human annotators marked under alternative lookalike categories.
hypotheses.falsifies_if: Predictions are chaotic noise with no relation to oceanographic signatures.

hypotheses.name: Historical OPS01 Result Was Artificially Optimistic (Pseudo-Replication)
hypotheses.description: OPS-01's ~40% mIoU was inflated because train and dev slices were randomly extracted from the same 27 parent scenes, allowing the network to memorize scene-specific radar characteristics.
hypotheses.evidence_available: OPS-01 design permitted spatial and temporal overlap between slices of the same scene.
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Evaluating an OPS-01 trained model on an along-track held-out scene from the same acquisition.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Examine historical C11/C12 parent accounting overlap tables.
hypotheses.supports_if: Historical cross-scene evaluation on OPS-01 dropped substantially when disjoint scenes were tested.
hypotheses.falsifies_if: OPS-01 models generalized well to genuinely disjoint datatakes.

hypotheses.name: Model Capacity / Inductive Bias Inadequacy
hypotheses.description: ResNet18-UNet (14.3M parameters) operating on uncalibrated 10x10 block-mean SAR DN lacks the capacity to disentangle 12 complex oceanic phenomena across global acquisitions without incidence angle conditioning.
hypotheses.evidence_available: 10x10 block averaging discards fine wave textural details (e.g. high-frequency pure ocean waves and ship point targets).
hypotheses.evidence_missing: Comparison against higher-capacity or multi-scale architectures on the same data.
hypotheses.cheapest_valid_diagnostic: Analyze feature map activations in the bottleneck decoder layers.
hypotheses.supports_if: Bottleneck features show class clustering collapse.
